kitSource.note: A consumer on an older kit keeps the duplicating dbpush until they upgrade — the half that protects users has the slower delivery path.

compliance.note: CC8.1 requires every production change to trace to a tracked item recording what changed, why, and who approved it. A sync tool that silently duplicates makes the tracked item cease to be a record of the change.
